text:
We celebrate the magic of open source, but we overlook a silent killer: the hidden cost of maintenance. 

Writing the initial code is a feat, but the real drain on developer energy is the "boring" upkeep—patching security vulnerabilities and managing shifting dependencies. Without dedicated funding for this continuous labor, the digital infrastructure we all rely on slowly decays. We must stop rewarding only the breakthrough features and start funding the essential stewardship that keeps our world running.
